errors.evidence: The description states that the categories on the horizontal axis are arranged in alphabetical order. The categories are "НЕЙНИЯТ ДЯЛ СЕ Е УВЕЛИЧИЛ", "НЯМА ПРОМЯНА", and "НЕЙНИЯТ ДЯЛ СЕ Е НАМАЛИЛ". This is not alphabetical order in Bulgarian; for example, 'Е' comes before 'Я', so an alphabetical sort would place "НЯМА ПРОМЯНА" after the other two.
The description states the legend is in the top right corner, but it is located at the top center of the chart.
